##### Project general facts

Aljada CBD Building 10 is a contemporary office building by Arada within the second cluster of the central business district of the Aljada community. Conceived as an innovative corporate hub, it combines a modern facade with functional design that fits naturally into the surrounding urban fabric. The building rises above two shared basement parking levels and a ground floor to seven commercial floors and a roof level, offering office suites together with a selection of retail units at street level.

The business environment is designed to support productivity and wellbeing. A welcoming lobby, lifts and concierge services create a professional first impression for staff and visitors, while advanced digital infrastructure with high-speed connectivity runs through the shared spaces. A rooftop terrace for relaxation, ground-floor dining and retail outlets, covered parking and round-the-clock security add everyday convenience, and walking paths, landscaped open areas and a forest walk sit close to the building.

Offices offer flexible open-plan layouts tailored to a wide range of business needs, from start-ups to established companies. Spaces are finished to a high standard and ready for commercial use, with generous floor plates and plenty of natural light. Retail units at ground level suit cafes, services and shops that serve the wider district, while a flexible layout allows each occupier to adapt the space to its brand and workflow.

##### Location description and benefits

Aljada is a large master-planned community in Sharjah that brings together homes, offices, retail, hospitality, education and leisure within one integrated urban setting. Its heart is Madar, a family entertainment destination designed by Zaha Hadid Architects, with parks, a skate park, a drive-in cinema, play areas and a wide choice of restaurants and cafes, alongside landscaped green spines and walkable streets.

Emirates Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and University City Road connect the community with the rest of Sharjah, Dubai and the northern emirates. Madar is a short walk away, Sharjah International Airport and University City are a short drive from the district, and Dubai International Airport and Downtown Dubai are within comfortable driving distance, making the location practical for staff and visiting clients.

Aljada is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the most ambitious mixed-use developments in Sharjah. Its central business district attracts companies seeking modern, well-connected workplaces at accessible prices compared with Dubai. A growing residential population, integrated retail and leisure and strong road links support steady demand from occupiers, underpinning healthy rental yields and long-term value for investors.
